title: terrain
summary: MSUI's OpenGL world pipeline covers per-tile ADT splat terrain, height queries, MCLQ liquid with depth fade and submerged tint, foliage, WMO/doodad rendering, and authored WoW lighting. SMSG_WEATHER drives the exact dual CMapWeather ramps, authored clear/storm lighting and cloud bias, plus a dedicated late-world precipitation lane. Rain streaks and animated Mod2x ground patters, projection-sized fading/settled snow, and fog-tinted companion mist use the reference spawn boxes, kinematics, density table, reference-30fps emission gain, player-motion wind lead and slab/streak tilts, collision-backed roof/floor landings, bounded pools, and type-cut behavior. A camera interior freezes simulation and drawing unless the completed WMO portal flood exposes an exterior group, preserving storms through doorways. Current Benilla explicitly defers sand particles to its later sand slice, so MSUI likewise keeps sand state/lighting-only rather than inventing a presentation. Clean build, focused WeatherClinicalChecks, full interface-wire-check, and actual decoding of all four weather BLPs pass; owner-run visual acceptance remains.

openItems.text: SMSG_WEATHER precipitation presentation remains: rain/snow/sand falling particles, rain ground patters, settled snow, companion mist, and the portal-aware outdoor/interior visibility gate. Packet decode, outdoor-only ambience, exact dual ~10-second effect/sky ramps, authored clear/storm lighting+fog interpolation, and CloudField storm bias/dimming are implemented.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: implemented the current Benilla rain/snow slice with authored streak/splash/flake/mist BLPs, collision-backed landing and roof rejection, ground patter/settled-snow lifetimes, fog-tinted mist with the density knee and wall-path truncation, player-motion wind lead and separate slab/streak tilts, and portal-aware WMO interior freeze/resume. Deterministic spawn/rate/geometry checks, actual client texture decodes, focused weather checks and the full suite pass. The stale sand wording was corrected: current Benilla explicitly defers sand particles and implements no sand simulation/draw path yet.

openItems.text: Owner-run visual acceptance in rain and snow at several grades: confirm streak/flakes fill the moving camera volume without being outrun, rain splashes and settled snow land on terrain/WMO roofs and floors, mist appears only above the 0.5 density knee and dies at walls, snow keeps its era-authored apparent size, and an interior freezes/hides the complete effect while an exterior-visible doorway keeps the storm moving. Confirm type changes drain live particles without cross-kind births and sand remains state/lighting-only like current Benilla.
